title: EhealthFog: criticality-aware task offloading for e-health monitoring in iFogSim2
description:
Extension of the iFogSim2 simulator that evaluates a criticality-aware offloading policy (CriticalityAware) for hospital e-health monitoring. Each Edge gateway forwards a critical tuple to the Fog node only when its own utilisation over the last 100 ms exceeds a threshold and the utilisation advertised by the Fog node is below a second threshold; otherwise the tuple is processed locally.

The package contains the per-tuple forwarding implementation (fair processor sharing, exact completion times, unicast return of results, per-tuple latency, transmitted bytes and busy-time energy), the scenario with three policies (Edge-local, Always-Fog, CriticalityAware), the scripts of the experimental campaign (500 runs in five experiment sets, 10 seeds per configuration) and the per-run summary of results used in the revised manuscript submitted to Sensors.

Version v1.1.1 adds experiment E5 (sensitivity to the Fog threshold) to v1.1.0, the version that replaced v1.0.0. Version v1.0.0 contained two configuration errors (the baseline placement policy was created before the controller and placed no modules; the analysis module was installed on only one gateway). Results obtained with v1.0.0 must not be used.
